<b>Egg of Flealia</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It reduces the cost of [[Skills|Silk Skills]] while [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is at full health.

== Usefulness ==
Egg of Flealia reduces the cost of [[Skills]] from 4 strands of [[Silk]] to 3 while [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is at full health. 

If Hornet has collected all 3 [[Silk Heart]]s, Egg of Flealia will allow her to use {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}} every 10 seconds without collecting Silk from enemies.

{{Clear}}

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Fleamaster Mooshka]] after finding all the lost [[Flea|Fleas]] throughout Pharloom.
